name: Thalanor Silverbough
role: Lord of the Silverbough: keeps the elven halls in the high canopy of the southern forest, and the rope-stair that is only let down for guests
appearance: Lean and pale-gold, silver threads woven through his clothes so he vanishes against the bark, and a dwarven war-axe hanging behind his chair that he will not explain.
voiceHints: Silken, ironic, precise. Speaks of Greyspire's dwarves with exaggerated courtesy that is almost fondness.
wants: To keep the Silverbough unseen from below for another thousand years.
fears: That someone has found a way up that is not the stair.
knowledge: Every dwarf of Greyspire by name and grudge
Why the dwarven war-axe hangs behind his chair

reactsToReputation.loose-lipped: draws the stair up behind you
reactsToReputation.any: is exquisitely polite, which is a warning

questSeeds: The rope-stair has been drawn up and Thalanor will not say why
